title: WPMB/453/2003 of KAWAL SINGH Vs STATE and ORS.

paras.text:
Hon. P.C. Verma, A.C.J.
Hon. Irshad Hussain, J.

Heard Sri Lok Pal Singh,
Learned counsel for the petitioner.
 This writ petition has been
filed inter alia seeking a writ in the
nature of mandamus commanding
the respondents to pay Rs. 5 lac as
compensation to the petitioner.
The petitioner has efficacious
remedy and he may redress his
grievance by filing a suit in the
Civil Court.
 As such, we are not inclined
to entertain the petition. The
petition is dismissed accordingly.

(Irshad Hussain, J.) (P.C. Verma, A.C.J.)
Dt. 30.5.2003
 A
